1 Getting Started

ODMatrix <- read_csv("data/aspatial/OD_Matrix.csv", skip = 0)

2.2 Cleaning and updating attribute fields of the geospatial data

eldercare <- eldercare %>%
  select(fid) %>%
  mutate(capacity = 100)
hexagons <- hexagons %>%
  select(fid) %>%
  mutate(demand = 100) %>%
  rename(id = fid)

3 Apsaital Data Handling and Wrangling

3.1 Importing Distance Matrix

ODMatrix_tidied <- ODMatrix %>%
  select(origin_id, destination_id, total_cost) %>%
  rename(from_id = origin_id,
         to_id = destination_id,
         dist = total_cost)
dist2closest <- cost_to_closest(
  travel_matrix = ODMatrix_tidied,
  land_use_data = hexagons,
  opportunity = "demand",
  travel_cost = "dist",
  n = 1,
  group_by = character(0),
  active = TRUE,
  fill_missing_ids = TRUE
)
hex_acc <- hexagons %>%
  left_join(dist2closest) %>%
  rename(dist2closest = dist)
mapex <- st_bbox(hex_acc)
tm_shape(hex_acc,
         bbox = mapex) + 
  tm_polygons(fill = "dist2closest", 
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile",
                n = 10,
                values = "-brewer.blues")) +
tm_shape(eldercare) +
  tm_dots(size = 0.3,
          fill = "red",
          col = "black") +
  tm_title("Accessibility to the closest eldercare") +
  tm_layout(frame = TRUE) +
  tm_compass(type="8star", size = 2) +
  tm_scalebar() +
  tm_grid(alpha = 0.2)

3.2 Tidying distance matrix

distmat <- ODMatrix %>%
  select(origin_id, destination_id, total_cost) %>%
  spread(destination_id, total_cost)%>%
  select(c(-c('origin_id')))

distmat_km <- as.matrix(distmat/1000)

4 Calculate Catchment Ratio

df_2sfca <- catchment_ratio(
  consumers = hexagons$demand,
  providers = eldercare$capacity,
  cost = distmat_km,
  max_cost = 5) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rename("2SFCA" = ".")

4.1 Mapping 2SFCA

hex_2SFCA <- bind_cols(hexagons, df_2sfca)
tm_shape(hex_2SFCA,
         bbox = mapex) + 
  tm_polygons(fill = "2SFCA", 
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile",
                n = 10,
                values = "-brewer.blues")) +
tm_shape(eldercare) + 
  tm_dots(size = 0.3,
          fill = "red",
          col = "black") +
  tm_title("2SFCA Accessibility measures") +
  tm_layout(frame = TRUE) + 
  tm_compass(type="8star", size = 2) +
  tm_scalebar() +
  tm_grid(alpha = 0.2)

4.2 Enhanced 2-step Floating Catchment

step_weights <- list(c(5, .01), c(4, .05), c(3, .1), c(2, .4), c(1, 1))
df_e2sfca <- catchment_ratio(
  consumers = hexagons$demand, 
  providers = eldercare$capacity,
  cost = distmat_km,
  weight = step_weights) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rename("E2SFCA" = ".")
hex_E2SFCA <- bind_cols(hexagons, df_e2sfca) 
tm_shape(hex_E2SFCA,
         bbox = mapex) + 
  tm_polygons(fill = "E2SFCA", 
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile",
                n = 10,
                values = "-brewer.blues")) +
tm_shape(eldercare) +
  tm_dots(size = 0.3,
          fill = "red",
          col = "black") +
  tm_title("E2SFCA Accessibility measures") +
  tm_layout(frame = TRUE) +
  tm_compass(type="8star", size = 2) +
  tm_scalebar() +
  tm_grid(alpha = 0.2)

4.4 3-step Floating Catchment Area

df_3sfca <- catchment_ratio(
  consumers = hexagons$demand, 
  providers = eldercare$capacity,
  cost = distmat_km,
  step_weights, 
  normalize_weight = TRUE) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rename("3SFCA" = ".")
hex_3SFCA <- bind_cols(hexagons, df_3sfca) 
tm_shape(hex_3SFCA,
         bbox = mapex) + 
  tm_polygons(fill = "3SFCA", 
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile",
                n = 10,
                values = "-brewer.blues")) +
tm_shape(eldercare) +
  tm_dots(size = 0.3,
          fill = "red",
          col = "black") +
  tm_title("3SFCA Accessibility measures") +
  tm_layout(frame = TRUE) +
  tm_compass(type="8star", size = 2) +
  tm_scalebar() +
  tm_grid(alpha = 0.2)
df_m2sfca <- catchment_ratio(
  consumers = hexagons$demand, 
  providers = eldercare$capacity,
  cost = distmat_km,
  step_weights, 
  adjust_providers = function(w) w^2) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rename("M2SFCA" = ".")
hex_M2SFCA <- bind_cols(hexagons, df_m2sfca) 
tm_shape(hex_M2SFCA,
         bbox = mapex) + 
  tm_polygons(fill = "M2SFCA", 
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile",
                n = 10,
                values = "-brewer.blues")) +
tm_shape(eldercare) +
  tm_dots(size = 0.3,
          fill = "red",
          col = "black") +
  tm_title("M2SFCA Accessibility measures") +
  tm_layout(frame = TRUE) +
  tm_compass(type="8star", size = 2) +
  tm_scalebar() +
  tm_grid(alpha = 0.2)
